_comment: Stoplight events registry. Standalone object; factors reference events by id (many-to-many via 'feeds'). Feeds: (1) the pull scheduler (billed sources fire on their event +1d; free sources poll), (2) the stale-counter, (3) the Catalysts sidebar strip. This registry holds ONLY dated catalysts + the weekly billed-sweep triggers. The 10 pure-poll factors (daily/weekly free FRED+yfinance pulls) are NOT events — they are listed in _pollers for reference and run on the clock, not off this calendar.
_role: SEED / TEMPLATE. The LIVE copy is stoplight_events.json at the REPO ROOT (next to stoplight_state.json); stoplight/events.py bootstraps root from this seed on first run, then auto-maintains root weekly (free pulls only). Edit this seed to change the authored non-earnings rows / wiring; delete the root copy to re-seed from here. Earnings 'ticker' fields drive the weekly yfinance date refresh.
_recurring_model: One row per RECURRING series (monthly releases, weekly sweeps, FOMC), NOT one row per occurrence. Each holds the NEXT date; refresh_calendar() rolls it forward once it passes (monthly = +1 month; weekly = +7d; FOMC = next entry in its 'schedule' list). The Catalysts view PROJECTS a recurring row forward to fill the 90-day window, so you still see ~3 upcoming PCE/FINRA prints without storing (and later duplicating) three rows. Discrete one-offs (earnings, self-gates) are single rows.
_pull_timing: DISPLAY date (next_date) vs BILLED-PULL date (pull_date) are different on purpose. A pull must never fire before the report lands. Earnings carry a 'session' (bmo/amc/unknown) that refresh_calendar() reads from the yfinance report time (~08:00 ET = before open; 16:00 ET = after close). pull_date = the event date for BMO (out before a same-day afternoon pull) or event+1 for AMC/unknown (let the print land + propagate — the same 'settle the noise' rule as FOMC, which is a 2pm announcement so it is +1 too). The compact-view marker always shows the EVENT date; pull_date is only the scheduler's fire time. NOTE: consumed by the event-driven billed scheduler (STOPLIGHT_SCHEDULING §6 step 4), which is NOT built yet — session/pull_date are populated and ready for it.
_rebuilt: 2026-07-20 (session 34). Earnings dates AUTO-PULLED live via yfinance get_earnings_dates() — replaces the prior hand-typed estimates (which had MSFT/GOOGL wrong at Oct; they report late Jul). date_status 'confirmed' = <=30d out (firm); 'estimate' = further out (yfinance provisional, re-pull as it nears). Monthly release dates (PCE/FINRA) are month-end estimates pending a FRED/BEA release-calendar pull; self-gates are computed (~63-bar off the June highs).
